reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/lsystem.rs acquires a CLOEXEC duplicate of stdin before tearing down the pager; shell commands and quoted strings are separate heap owners, while save_ifile holds the selected input across handoff.
owner_creation.invariant: A stdin backup must exist before changing the active descriptor.
limitations: Saved input ownership is separate from temporary shell-command bytes.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/lsystem.rs borrows cmd/donemsg through synchronous execution, keeps an IFILE hold through reopen and distinguishes opened tty ownership from borrowed fallback. Only tty.owned permits closing the temporary tty FD.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A numeric descriptor slot does not establish close ownership.
limitations: The raw saved IFILE still depends on edit-side hold and list discipline.

callback_targets.analysis: src/lsystem.rs calls system and popen directly and switches signal dispositions around pipe output. The SIGPIPE ignore integer is still transmuted to a Rust handler representation, linked to M0-SIG-004.
callback_targets.invariant: Native process and signal targets must use valid callable/sentinel representations.
limitations: No general signal ABI approval follows from successful stdin restoration.

invalidation.analysis: src/lsystem.rs dup2 replaces fd 0 without closing its backup, then closes only an owned tty duplicate. Restoration uses the independent saved FD before the pager can resume input.
invalidation.invariant: The backup remains valid until all descriptor swaps are finished.
limitations: Current ownership fixes do not close IND-FD-F3 by source review alone.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/lsystem.rs checks backup acquisition before any terminal teardown, retries interrupted dup2 and resumes only after restoring stdin. The current source repairs the historical M0-IO-003 teardown ordering.
mutation_commit.invariant: Commit to shell mode requires a recoverable original input owner.
limitations: Terminal state and saved IFILE restoration remain separate coordinated transitions.

release_pair.analysis: src/lsystem.rs frees the constructed command after system and closes its stdin backup after restoration; pipe_data consumes its popen stream with pclose and restores signal/terminal state afterward.
release_pair.invariant: Heap command, backup FD and process FILE need their distinct counterparts.
limitations: The pclose result is not checked as a complete child-success proof.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/lsystem.rs backup failure diagnoses and returns untouched; failed tty setup restores from backup or exits cooked if restoration fails. That exit avoids running pager cleanup against the wrong input descriptor.
error_cleanup.invariant: Do not resume or run ordinary quit cleanup with un-restored stdin.
limitations: No independent descriptor-exhaustion campaign was run for this packet.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/lsystem.rs disables and reenables handlers around external execution but still shares raw input, screen and signal state. Pipe SIGPIPE sentinel conversion remains open under M0-SIG-004, separate from resource provenance.
signals_handoff.invariant: Signal disposition changes must not imply an exclusive owner handoff.
limitations: M0-MEM-001 retains the broader raw cross-module handoff obligation.
